abilities.name: Minigun
abilities.text: Activate to have Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 2.5% of their maximum Health. Lasts 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Overkill
abilities.text: Deal 552 damage to the target and 276 damage to nearby targets over 4 seconds. Reactivate to select a new target or direction. Can move and use Abilities while Channeling.

abilities.name: Frag Grenade
abilities.text: Lob a grenade that deals 256 damage, knocking enemies away.

abilities.name: Drakken Laser Drill
abilities.text: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142 damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Loses Health over 25 seconds.

abilities.name: Commandeer Odin
abilities.text: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

1.name: Quarterback
1.text: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 45%.

1.name: Dash
1.text: Increase the range of Run and Gun by 50%. When cast, increase Tychus's Movement Speed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

1.name: Press the Advantage
1.text: Increase Tychus's Basic Attack range by 1.

4.name: In the Rhythm
4.text: Quest: While Minigun is active, Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increase future Minigun durations by 0.03 seconds.

4.name: The Bigger They Are...
4.text: Increase the damage bonus to 4% while enemy Heroes are above 30% Health, but Minigun no longer has any effect on targets below 30%.

4.name: Master Assassin
4.text:
Passive: Increase Tychus's Attack Speed by 10%.

Reward: After getting 15 Takedowns, Tychus's Attack Speed is increased by an additional 15%.

7.name: Melting Point
7.text: Enemies hit by Frag Grenade take an additional 75 damage over 3 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% against Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

7.name: Combat Tactician
7.text: Reduce the cooldown of Minigun by 4 seconds. Reduce the cooldown of Minigun by an additional 4 seconds after using Run and Gun.

7.name: Relentless Soldier
7.text: Being Stunned or Rooted grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

10.name: Commandeer Odin
10.text: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

10.name: Drakken Laser Drill
10.text: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142 damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Loses Health over 25 seconds.

13.name: Spray 'n' Pray
13.text: Overkill Slows enemy Movement Speed by 25% and its range is increased by 25%.

13.name: That's the Stuff!
13.text: Minigun heals Tychus for 100% of the bonus damage dealt after it expires.

13.name: Neosteel Coating
13.text: Activate to gain 75 Spell Armor for 4 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

16.name: Armor Piercing Rounds
16.text: Each time Overkill hits an enemy, its damage against them is increased by 15%, stacking up to 60% bonus damage.

16.name: Titan Grenade
16.text: Frag Grenade deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their maximum Health. Each enemy Hero hit by Frag Grenade reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

16.name: Sizzlin' Attacks
16.text: Basic Attacks deal bonus damage to Heroes equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Stacks with Minigun.

20.name: Big Red Button
20.text: Odin lasts 50% longer and Ragnarok Missiles also launches a Nuclear Missile which lands 2.5 seconds later, dealing 319 damage in its area.

20.name: Focusing Diodes
20.text: Increases the range of the Drakken Laser Drill by 50%. Deals increasing damage the longer it remains on a single target, up to 100% additional damage.

20.name: Can Do This All Day
20.text: Reduce Overkill's cooldown by 5 seconds. While Channeling Overkill, Tychus gains 40 Armor.

20.name: Bob and Weave
20.text: Run and Gun and Odin's Thrusters gain 2 additional charges and reduces Run and Gun's Mana cost from 50 to 25. After using Run and Gun, increase Tychus's Basic Attack range by 1.5 for 4 seconds.
